chapters.title: A Home That Smelled of Toast
chapters.turn: Nika brings Mriya home; mutual routines create a fragile but sincere domestic refuge.

chapters.title: The Wrong Smell
chapters.turn: Mriya detects an intentional hidden scent beneath an ordinary delivery route and chooses to follow it.

chapters.title: The Hand in the Tunnel
chapters.turn: A capture attempt in a service tunnel becomes a near-death event and awakens the System.

chapters.title: Cached Relief
chapters.turn: The first Cache calms Nika and makes home feel unnaturally perfect.

chapters.title: Before Waking
chapters.turn: Mriya learns the calming resource must be shut down before its human user wakes.

chapters.title: A Better Morning
chapters.turn: Mriya saves Nika but keeps part of the resource, establishing the first secret between them.

chapters.title: Recognized Authority
chapters.turn: The System rewards a human for obeying a dog’s warning and penalizes another for ignoring it.

chapters.title: Good Girl
chapters.turn: Nika’s praise becomes measurable Favor, making affection feel transactional for the first time.

chapters.title: The Price of Disbelief
chapters.turn: A frightened neighbor rejects canine authority and triggers a threat that drives Mriya from the apartment.

chapters.title: Good Dog / Bad Dog
chapters.turn: The System offers the binary class choice while Atlas demands obedience and Pixel urges theft.

chapters.title: Neither
chapters.turn: Mriya refuses both paths and loses easy rewards.

chapters.title: Stray Class
chapters.turn: A negotiated act of loyalty unlocks Stray and lets the dogs form a voluntary party.

chapters.title: The Ruined Room
chapters.turn: The party finds an abandoned sanitation room beneath a municipal depot.

chapters.title: What Counts as Clean
chapters.turn: Restoration requires each inhabitant to surrender a private scent marker.

chapters.title: Pack Hearth
chapters.turn: The facility heals Mriya’s old pain but broadcasts the settlement to rival dogs.

chapters.title: Three Empty Bowls
chapters.turn: A sharing ritual creates three human-sized claims on the Hearth’s scarce supply.

chapters.title: Delivered People
chapters.turn: Tomas, Irena and Vale arrive through different routes and assume different owners.

chapters.title: House Rules
chapters.turn: Mriya must define rules that humans and dogs can both accept before the Hearth rejects them.

chapters.title: Bond Treatment
chapters.turn: Nika’s worsening exhaustion becomes the first test of a Bond healing skill.

chapters.title: Useful Happiness
chapters.turn: The skill works and makes Nika productive, cheerful and subtly unable to leave Mriya.

chapters.title: Let Go
chapters.turn: Mriya weakens her own Bond to restore Nika’s choice, sacrificing a major advantage.

chapters.title: Assembly Required
chapters.turn: The Hearth receives expansion modules designed for incompatible species and social roles.

chapters.title: Pieces That Refuse
chapters.turn: Atlas imposes order, Pixel cheats the build and the settlement physically locks them out.

chapters.title: A Door for Everyone
chapters.turn: Mriya solves the build through negotiated access rather than one universal entrance.

chapters.title: Human Food
chapters.turn: A valuable human consumable poisons a dog and turns Supply into a species conflict.

chapters.title: Bad Medicine
chapters.turn: A prohibited Cache revives a collapsing human, exposing unequal System values.

chapters.title: Different Rules
chapters.turn: The pack chooses separate resource laws and loses the System’s efficiency bonus.

chapters.title: Rook
chapters.turn: A rival enforcer enters the Hearth to collect territory tribute.

chapters.title: A Tool Worth Biting
chapters.turn: Rook’s respect for a pack-built tool interrupts violence and opens negotiation.

chapters.title: Conditional Ally
chapters.turn: Rook joins for one defense and reveals the city’s emerging pack hierarchy.

chapters.title: The Right Face
chapters.turn: Nika returns after a disappearance looking correct and smelling wrong.

chapters.title: The Wrong Nika
chapters.turn: The impostor uses Mriya’s Bond permissions to open the Hearth to the System.

chapters.title: Chosen Scent
chapters.turn: The real Nika proves identity through a shared routine that the System never measured.

chapters.title: Custodian 0.03
chapters.turn: Mriya discovers a miniature administrator harvesting resources from urban insects.

chapters.title: Stable Dependency
chapters.turn: The Custodian offers a charter if Mriya proves that humans depend on the Pack Hearth.

chapters.title: Good Dogs of Vesper
chapters.turn: Mriya secures the charter by redefining dependency as reciprocal duty; the Hearth survives as canine interfaces awaken across the city.
